messages:
Lena Morris: Quick thread 1: EU / GovCloud requirements popped up from a partner. Need to capture differences for packaging + legal before we push listings.
Carlos Jimenez: Which marketplaces? Azure GOV, AWS GovCloud (US), and EU regions on GCP. Partner flagged data residency + export controls.
Tasha Reed: I can do the compliance mapping. Need owners for: image maintenance, legal acceptance of DPA, and billing model alignment.
legal-bot: Reminder: any GovCloud offering must include approved DPA + export control clause ID: EXP-2026-02. Attach signed doc before publish.
Lena Morris: Action: Carlos you take image/AMI build owner for GovCloud AMIs. Tasha you take compliance mapping doc. I'll own the marketplace manifest fields and pricing notes.
Carlos Jimenez: Ack. I'll add build pipeline notes: AMI naming convention `rwd-gov-<region>-<hash>` and automated Packer + Inspec scans. Will also include `maintainer` field in manifest.
Tasha Reed: Compliance checklist draft: data_residency: yes, encryption_at_rest: kms, export_control: EXP-2026-02, audit_logs: enabled, subcontractors: list. Will paste snippet into the onboarding doc.
partner-ops: Partner asks whether Dedicated customers can still get deployments in GovCloud. Short answer: yes, but it's a separate AMI/instance offer and slower review. Expect 3-4 week validation.
Lena Morris: Good to know. For marketplace packaging: do we need separate SKUs for GovCloud vs public regions? Thoughts?
Carlos Jimenez: Yes. Marketplaces generally want region-specific SKUs for AMIs. For SaaS offers we can use a single SaaS SKU but add `region_restriction` metadata.
legal-bot: Note: marketing copy for GovCloud cannot imply certifications we don't have (e.g., do not claim IL5 unless we have audit evidence). Keep copy conservative.
Tasha Reed: Also flag that EU customers often prefer contract language in local languages. Legal wants a translation plan for DE/FR/NL. Adding translation_owner: legal_ops to doc.
Lena Morris: For billing, partner wants subscription for Gov customers. We need to note equivalent per-token mapping if customers want usage billing. Carlos can you draft a pricing example?
Carlos Jimenez: Will add pricing rows: `gov-subscription-1000`: 100 seats/month, and `gov-per-token`: 0.0009 per token, plus marketplace_fee percentage.
partner-ops: Partner wants SLA adjustments for GovCloud customers (longer lead times for failover). Add `sla_notes` field to the offer manifest.
Lena Morris: Ops-bot, can you add a checklist item for failover runbooks required for GovCloud offers?
ops-bot: Checklist updated: add runbook_govcloud.md required. Auto-assign to eng-oncall.
Tasha Reed: One more: export-control review required for models that include encryption libraries from disallowed countries. Legal will run a quick review.
legal-bot: Export-control review assigned to legal-team. Expected turnaround 72 hours.
Carlos Jimenez: I'll include AMI metadata sample in the doc: { "ami": { "name": "rwd-gov-eu-west-1-202603", "maintainer": "Carlos J.", "scans_attested": true } }
Lena Morris: Timeline: consolidate checklist by this Friday, then partner review next week. If no blockers, aim to submit AWS GovCloud and Azure Gov offers in two weeks.
partner-ops: I'll coordinate partner-facing comms and prepare a short FAQ on region differences.
Tasha Reed: Uploaded compliance draft and translation plan link: https://docs.internal/redwood/marketplace/govcloud-compliance (draft). Please add comments.
Lena Morris: Thanks all 1: Let's reconvene if legal raises any red flags.
